spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ9/Q5 'auth flow auto-provisions tenants, expanding attack surface'. This is Q-approved security boundary: (a) INMA welcome introspection already gates — only valid INMA users reach resolver; (b) new tenant is empty (no data, no integrations, no secrets); (c) rate limit + super-admin alert backlog; (d) 'onboarding required' alternative rejected by Q (manual step unacceptable for legitimate customers). For existing tenant 5050 (backfilled inma_code='5050'), returned value stays 5050 (unchanged). For new INMA tenants (e.g. DentAdavista), returned value is the auto-generated sequence ID (100_000_000+).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ10 'insufficient evidence tenant_id response semantics client-compatible'. Dashboard React client (src/Invekto.Backend/Dashboard) stores entire auth response verbatim and re-uses JWT for authorization; the 'tenant_id' response field is not used as a routing key — JWT is the source of truth. Backfill ensures 5050 numeric continuity; new tenants get sequence IDs (always >100M, distinguishable).

plan.summary: INMA tarafi CompanyCode claim'ini her zaman **opaque string** olarak gonderdigini netlestirdi (5050='5050' numeric string, DentAdavista='dentadavista' non-numeric). INSE `InmaTokenIntrospector.ParseClaims` `int.TryParse(CompanyCode)` yapiyordu - non-numeric codes `INV-AUTH-002 Missing or invalid CompanyCode/CompanyId claim` ile reddediliyordu. Fix: (1) `InmaTokenContext.TenantId:int` -> `CompanyCode:string` (DTO refactor, sadece Backend tuketici); (2) Introspector CompanyCode'u trim + boş/max-len validate ederek string dondurur, `CompanyId` fallback ve `int.TryParse` silinir; (3) yeni migration 016 `tenant_registry_auto_id_seq` sequence (start 100_000_000, mevcut max 40_695_541 cok uzerinde) + backfill `UPDATE tenant_registry SET inma_code='5050' WHERE tenant_id=5050`; (4) `TenantRegistryRepository.ResolveOrCreateByInmaCodeAsync(string code, string displayName)` method - SELECT by inma_code + miss halinde INSERT nextval() ON CONFLICT (inma_code) WHERE inma_code IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING, RETURNING bossa re-SELECT (race-safe); (5) Backend Program.cs 3 nokta guncelleme: `ExtractTenantFromBearer` (helper), `/api/v1/inma/auth/exchange` ve `/api/v1/inma/auth/login` endpoint'leri - introspector sonrasi resolver call + int tenant_id ile INSE JWT generation. Lisans kontrolu YOK (Q: 'lisansi INMA yonetecek'). Migration 009 NOTE'unda bu lazy-provision deseni zaten dokumante edilmis (UP0.3 planli).

Lisans kavrami INSE'ye EKLENMEYECEK (INMA yonetir). INSE tenant_registry/license kolonu yok, INMA MSSQL readonly (yazma izni yok).
plan.interview_notes: Q 3 kritik sorunun hepsini 'Recommended' ile onayladi: auto-create (ghost risk kabul edilir, sebep: prod'da ilk login eden firmayi Q manuel onboard etmek istemiyor), 5050 spesifik backfill (diger NULL tenant'lara dokunulmaz), nameidentifier int kalsin (INMA'dan netlestirme beklenmez). tenant_id auto-gen: sequence 100_000_000+ (mevcut 40695541 max + voila/mlpcm/elodi seviyesi 14M-40M arasi, 100M cok uzerinde collision-free). Default values: tenant_name=CompanyCode, is_active=true, plan_tier default 'baslangic' (kolon default), features/settings_json=null, sector=null. Feature flag'leri JWT 'InseFeatures' claim'inden FeatureFlagService cache'e zaten yaziliyor (tenant+user scoped) - auto-create tenant'ta da calisir.

Auto-create ghost tenant riski: herhangi bir gecerli INMA JWT (introspection welcome 200) ile unknown CompanyCode -> yeni tenant_registry row olusur. Attack vector: attacker WapCRM'e gecerli kullanici yarattip INSE'yi spamler. Mitigation: (a) welcome introspection zaten INMA-side auth gate (sadece gecerli INMA user token'lari gelir); (b) yeni tenant is_active=true ama features_json=null, sector=null - ozel bir sey yapamaz login ekrani disinda; (c) rate limit + super-admin dashboard 'new tenants this hour' uyarisi (backlog). Kabul edilebilir risk mi?
